original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an AWS KMS customer-managed key with key rotation enabled, for encrypting database backups.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an AWS KMS customer-managed key with key rotation enabled, for encrypting database backups.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: KMS CMK with rotation enabled for encrypting database backups

Parameters:
  AliasName:
    Type: String
    Default: alias/db-backup-kms-key
    AllowedPattern: ^alias\/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+$
    Description: KMS alias name (must start with alias/)
  KeyDeletionWindowInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 7
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Waiting period (in days) before KMS key is deleted after scheduled deletion
  MultiRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Whether to create a multi-Region key

Conditions:
  UseMultiRegion: !Equals [!Ref MultiRegion, 'true']

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting database backups
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      MultiRegion: !If [UseMultiRegion, true, false]
      PendingWindowInDays: !Ref KeyDeletionWindowInDays
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowRDSAndBackupUseOfTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - rds.amazonaws.com
                - backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ForAnyValue:StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService:
                  - !Sub rds.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}
                  - !Sub backup.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}
              Bool:
                kms:GrantIsForAWSResource: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AliasName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: database-backup-encryption

  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref AliasName
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

Outputs:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyArn
  KmsKeyId:
    Description: ID of the KMS key
    Value: !Ref KmsKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyId
  KmsAliasName:
    Description: KMS alias name
    Value: !Ref KmsAlias
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-KmsAliasName
  KmsAliasArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS alias
    Value: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${AliasName}
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-KmsAliasArn
